scholarships.name: International Brock Scholars Award
renewal_conditions: *Subject to annual approval by the Board of Trustees

Your admission average is calculated using the prerequisites for your offered program of study. A Brock Scholars Award is offered at the time of admission and may increase or decrease if your final average changes. Students entering from the U.S.A are eligible for the Domestic Brock Scholars Entrance Award. International students who become domestic students or have status to pay the equivalent to domestic tuitions will have their International Brock Scholars award converted to the Domestic Brock Scholars to align with the change to domestic fees.
** Brock Scholars awards are renewable for up to three years. Students pursuing a three-year degree will be eligible for two renewals. For complete renewal requirements and terms, please click here .

scholarships.name: Brock Future Leaders Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: 10 awards available. Must meet requirements and may only be combined with the Brock Scholars Award. Selection by committee. Apply below.

scholarships.name: International Curriculum awards
scholarships.eligibility: Awarded to the first 20 accepted students who are admitted as international fee-paying students, have graduated from a high school outside of Canada, paid their deposit, and hold an international curriculum.

scholarships.name: International Ambassador Award
scholarships.eligibility: Must meet requirements. Selection by committee. Apply below.

scholarships.name: The Caribbean International Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Awarded to two (2) 1st year undergraduate students, admitted as international fee-paying students who show academic promise and financial need. Applicable countries: Cuba; Haiti; Dominican Republic; Jamaica; Trinidad & Tobago; Guadeloupe; Martinique; Bahamas; Barbados; Saint Lucia; Curacao; Aruba; Saint Vincent and the Grenadines; Grenada; Antigua and Barbuda; Dominica; Cayman Islands; Saint Kitts & Nevis; Saint Maarten; Turks & Caicos Islands; Saint Martin; British Virgin Islands; Caribbean Netherlands; Anguilla; Saint Barthelemy and Montserrat

scholarships.name: Brock Canadian High School Excellence Award
scholarships.eligibility: Awarded to the first 30 accepted students who are admitted as international fee-paying students, have paid their deposit and graduate from high school in Canada.

scholarships.name: International Transfer Award
scholarships.eligibility: Awarded to the first 10 accepted students who are admitted as international fee-paying students, have paid their deposit and transferred at least 0.5 credits.
